NEW: a global, permanent stats accumulator, small memory footprint (a handful of numbers), so subagent work done is understandable over time.

Spec:
- Hook: fold a departing record's stats into the store in removeRecord (single funnel for cleanup timer + clearCompleted evictions). Optionally also on dispose().
- Fields per record: lifetimeUsage {input, output, cacheWrite, cacheRead, cost}, toolUses, durationMs, run count.
- Display: /agents menu — 'Session total' (existing fd1e0c4, session-scoped) stays; add an 'All-time total' line from the permanent store (weighted token formula per Decision 2, cost via formatCost).
- Widget/viewer optionally show store totals later.

FLAGGED SUB-QUESTION (apply time, or answer now): 'permanent' = (a) in-memory module-level accumulator surviving /new and agent cleanup for the pi process lifetime, or (b) file-backed (e.g. .pi/agents-stats.json) surviving pi restarts. Default plan: (a) in-memory — matches 'small memory footprint'; upgrade path to (b) is a serialization wrapper. See REBASE-NOTES.md inventory #16 (4600cac).

title: Limit subagent session by max context length (like maxTurns)
description:
New feature (user request). The subagent session itself is capped by context length -- analogous to the existing {"maxTurns"} limit, but for the session's context usage rather than turn count. When the subagent's context window usage crosses the cap, the session terminates (hard stop/wrap-up, like a turn-limit wrap-up).

Design questions at apply time, worked by the implementing agent:
- param/setting surface: a per-call param (e.g. maxContextLength / contextLimit), an agent-type setting, or a global default; override semantics vs fork's param-as-override model (Decision 1, REBASE-DECISIONS.md)
- units: tokens vs % of window; where to read the subagent's current context usage (the extension tracks usage/per-session context -- see usage.ts, 498cb14 buildSessionContext, widget ctx-length display from fd1e0c4)
- termination semantics: wrap-up on threshold like turn limit; message/status shown in result; interplay with turn limit and budget-based stopping
- relationship to lifetime-stats work (tintinweb-pi-subagents-7u2) for reporting usage at termination

Links: turns limit already exists on Agent tool; REBASE-NOTES.md inventory for context handling.

title: Investigate tracing subagent session stats (tokens/cost) in the main agent log file
description:
New feature (user request, not part of the rebase decisions). Related to the lifetime-stats store (tintinweb-pi-subagents-7u2).

Investigate whether/how subagent session stats (tokens in/out, cache read/write, cost, turns, tool uses) can be traced in the MAIN agent's log file, e.g. alongside or interleaved with the parent session's usage/log output. Should explore: existing logging/tracing in the extension and pi host, whether subagent LIFETIME/usage data is already written anywhere (output transcript files, session files), and what a minimal mechanism looks like (line-oriented 'subagent stats' emission, JSONL, structured log events). Deliverable of this issue: findings + a concrete recommendation (and, if approved in the same work, the tracing emission itself).

Links: lifetime-stats store (tintinweb-pi-subagents-7u2), Decision 6 (REBASE-DECISIONS.md), widget/viewer cost+token display (fd1e0c4 in fork, master #243/#257).

title: Print subagent session stats to the user when the agent terminates
description:
New feature (user request, not part of the rebase decisions). Dependent on the tracing investigation (tintinweb-pi-subagents-dng).

Related to the previous: at minimum, print the subagent session stats (tokens in/out, weighted total, cost, duration, turns/tool uses) for the user when the agent terminates — i.e. a per-subagent stats summary surfaced in the parent's output at completion time, not only inside the widget/UI.

Design questions at apply time:
- where exactly 'on terminate' hooks (final result wrap, completion notification render)
- format for the user (single-line summary vs block), reuse formatCost/formatCount/weighted token formula (Decision 2, tintinweb-pi-subagents-g5m)
- relationship to the lifetime-stats store (tintinweb-pi-subagents-7u2) and the log-file tracing (tintinweb-pi-subagents-dng): this issue is the user-visible print; may be satisfied directly by data already flowing through the widget/viewer paths.

Blocked by: tintinweb-pi-subagents-dng (investigation) for the full story, but print implementation can proceed from existing surfaces.
